exposure: Comprehensive nursing combined with ISBAR handover approach
Conventional basic nursing combined with traditional handover tool intervention
outcome: Psychological burden (S-AI, T-AI, DT, GSES scores)
cohort: The study included 80 patients with placental abruption admitted to a women's hospital, divided into a control group (May 2021-May 2022) and an observation group (June 2022-June 2023).
finding: Comprehensive nursing combined with the ISBAR handover approach improved maternal and infant outcomes, enhanced the quality of nurses' shift handovers, reduced patients' psychological burden, and increased nursing satisfaction in patients with placental abruption.
mod_finding: The observation group, which received comprehensive nursing and ISBAR handover, had a higher rate of normal delivery and a lower rate of cesarean section compared to the control group.
followup_time: 5 minutes after birth (for Apgar scores), otherwise N/A beyond immediate hospital stay.
